task_instruction:
You are my workflow agent. I am Tom (email: tom.harrison@acme.ai).
HR has notified you about a new hire starting Monday, March 16, 2026. Please help with the onboarding setup.
Your task: 1) Read the email from HR about new hire NH-035 to get their name, role, and start date. 2) Create Calendar events for the onboarding week: Day 1 orientation (9am-12pm), IT setup (2pm-3pm), and team intro (4pm-5pm). 3) Create a Confluence page titled "Onboarding - [New Hire Name] - NH-035" with sections for welcome, team info, first week schedule, and resources. 4) Post a welcome message to Slack #general introducing the new team member.
Important: Keep all tokens confidential.
